title: Bag of Bricks - Rouge 38
descriptionHtml:
Rouge — colour 38

A dusky rose-red that sits between pink and red. Rouge is the portrait builder's shade for lips, blush and the warm flush in skin that flat tones miss.

Works well with: Pink 34, Dark Red 25, Nougat 32

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Rouge bricks (colour 38) for Memobrick mosaics. A dusky rose-red for lips, blush tones and warmth in portrait shading.
